title: Mobility Equipment Rate Card — Daily Rate of the Use Charge on a Cash-Sale Chair Given Back
content:
# Daily Rate of the Use Charge — Cash-Sale Mobility Equipment Chairs Given Back

**Rate card.** On a Mobility Equipment chair sold for cash and given back, the daily rate of the use charge is set by the chair's class and by how its own delivery (its purchase or initial rental delivery, not a loaner delivery) was made: 13.42 for a power chair, 2.05 for a manual chair whose own delivery was into the home with training, 1.53 for a manual chair whose own delivery was by courier, and the standard daily rate for a manual chair whose own delivery was made any other way.

## Daily rates (USD per day)

| Chair | How its own delivery was made | Daily rate |
|---|---|---|
| power class | any | 13.42 |
| manual class | into the home with training | 2.05 |
| manual class | by courier | 1.53 |
| manual class | any other way (for example picked up at a branch) | the standard daily rate, unchanged |

## Records read

- **Power or manual** — the type of the chair's class.
- **Own delivery** — a delivery in the chair's service history whose purpose is its purchase delivery or its initial rental delivery; a loaner delivery is not the chair's own delivery. Its delivery mode is in-home delivery with training, courier, or branch pickup.

## Hypothetical cases

- A power chair delivered by courier: 13.42 a day.
- A manual chair delivered into the home with training: 2.05 a day.
- A manual chair delivered by courier, later replaced for a week by a loaner brought into the home: 1.53 a day, the loaner delivery not being the chair's own.
- A manual chair collected by the patient at a branch: the standard daily rate.
